svg.title: Infrastructure sketches
svg.desc: Put the rack, directory, empty room and text strip on a common sketch surface. Reuse their incident geometry so the reader can see the visual vocabulary being deliberately selected. The operations-room sketch uses the same fluorescent-wall geometry as the reconstructed response setting.
